description: Defines the EmployeeImmigrationModel class used for serializing employee immigration data within the OrangeHRM project. It maps entity data to API response structure, including properties such as ID, number, issue and expiry dates, type, status, review date, country info, and comments.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationModel
classes.description: A model class used for representing employee immigration data within the API, facilitating serialization and property mapping from the EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
